US Air Force Officer Recounts Being Shot Down Over Iran

A U.S. Air Force officer described his experience of being shot down over Iran and his subsequent rescue. He recounted the moments of free-falling after his jet was downed, during which he prayed. The officer shared details of his harrowing ordeal, including being behind enemy lines. The incident involved his aircraft being shot down, leading to a rescue operation.
